description:
Open an image file as a new Photoshop document.

Use when: user provides a file path to edit or no document is open yet.
Do NOT use when: adding to an existing composite — use photoshop_place_image.

Returns: document id, name, width, height.
Preconditions: file must exist on disk. Side effects: opens document as active.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

filePath.description: Full path to the image file

name: photoshop_open_image
